<thought>Based on the dominant m/z 179.0946 peak, the ion is likely a protonated molecule ([M+H]+). Subtracting the proton mass gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ~178.087 Da. The closest simple organic formula matching this mass, considering typical C/H/O composition and the observed ~10 % M+1 intensity (≈10 carbons), is C9H10O3. This fits within a reasonable mass error for a single measurement.</thought>
<final_answer>C9H10O3</final_answer>
